name: maze-maker
description: Maze maker: generate square, circular, triangular, hexagonal, star and heart-shaped mazes with seven algorithms (backtracker, Prim, Kruskal, Wilson, hunt-and-kill, growing tree, Aldous-Broder), solve them with the keyboard or a finger, and export them as SVG or PNG.
author: Olivier Giulieri (https://evoluteur.github.io/)
